{{Infobox auto}}

'''Sweet berry jam''' is the preservation of [[Sweet Berries|sweet berries]]. It heals {{Value|Sweet Berry Jam|heals}} and grants {{EffectLink|Health Boost}} for {{Value|Sweet Berry Jam|duration|effect=Health Boost}}.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/sweet_berry_jam.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
[[Sweet Berry Mash|Sweet berry mash]], sugar and a glass bottle. Obtaining sweet berry mash unlocks the recipe.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating sweet berry jam takes {{Value|Sweet Berry Jam|eat_time}}, heals {{Value|Sweet Berry Jam|heals}} and gives Health Boost {{Value|Sweet Berry Jam|level|effect=Health Boost}} (+2 hearts of maximum health) for {{Value|Sweet Berry Jam|duration|effect=Health Boost|format=clock}}. It gives the glass bottle back when eaten.
